## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. An app under `os serve` has a declared way to leave out `plugin-auth`'s organization page, and the conflict's remedy names a step its holder can take

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T17:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-checked on `origin/main`:**
  - `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:3998` and `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.ts:715` construct `AuthPlugin` from a fixed option set, so PR #23309's `registerOrganizationRecordPage` cannot be reached from either root.
  - The refusal's remedy, "compose the deployment without the package that ships the other", is at `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:1779`.
- **Why p3:** no app under `os serve` has been measured shipping its own `sys_organization` default page. Cloud composes its own kernel and sets the option (objectstack-ai/cloud#2773). The misleading remedy is a trap for an author or an AI, but it fails loudly at boot.
- **Lane:** a stack-config input, or a derivation, that `os serve` and `DevPlugin` accept widens what those roots accept, so `Clause-②: yes`: spec-lane work with contract-tier review, whichever seat found it. The claim declares the `cli`, `plugin-dev` and `objectql` files.
- **Direction: the card's ask, as written.** The seat measures which spelling fits: forwarding the option from the stack's config, or deriving it from an app's own declared default page. ⛔ No precedence ladder and ⛔ no registration-order rule (ruling A on #23015). The remedy sentence is reworded generically and names no option and no tracker number. Pins with negative controls, as the card lists.
- Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`domain:spec`, Clause-② yes); rationale: every composition root can take ruling A's switch.

Claim: PM loop round 5

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (no path-derived mandate; floor · default · ceiling); Clause-② yes ⇒ CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review before the queue`
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: `n/a — PR #23309 (#23254) added the option for hosts that compose their own kernel; the CLI roots were outside that card's surface`
Thread-read: 6151745744
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin.ts` or `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (read at this act across every open PR's file list). PR #23461 (another seat's, ADR-0131 D10 boot guard) touches `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` in a separate hunk (~3862, step 5c-ter); `serve.ts` is not a single-claim path, and whichever of the two lands later merges `main` and re-runs its gates.

Read on `origin/main` `fba37122b` at 2026-10-14T20:09Z: `serve.ts:3998` and `dev-plugin.ts:715` construct `AuthPlugin` with no `registerOrganizationRecordPage`; the remedy at `registry.ts:1779` reads "compose the deployment without the package that ships the other".

## Review: ACCEPT · PR #23550 @ `c2db30e78717c3237cef19631fc77bf6dc95091c` · `domain:spec` seat 3 · 2026-10-14T22:41Z

Session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz` · `baozhoutao`. Reviewer of record; checked against GitHub, not the report.

- **Shape:** draft, `Fixes #23310`, `Clause-②: yes`; +610/−5, 12 files; not governed. Contract-tier review on the PR: **PASS** on this head.
- **Derive, as measured:** `os serve` and `DevPlugin` pass `registerOrganizationRecordPage: !stackDeclaresOrganizationRecordPage(...)`. The new `@objectstack/core` predicate is one yes/no on the served app's declared default record page for `sys_organization`, read with `defaultRecordPageObject`, the same reading every refusal door uses. It has no ordering or precedence rule (ruling A on #23015), and it adds no stack-config key. A host that composes its own `AuthPlugin` keeps its own option.
- **Remedy:** `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` now reads "…or compose the deployment without the other package's page", naming no option, package or tracker number; the new pin asserts it verbatim.
- **Pins:** core truth table, `DevPlugin` recorded option, the `serve.ts` construction pin (unit tier), and a nightly-tier real `os serve` e2e (app page is the single default; control: `plugin-auth`'s page). Each pin has its negative control.
- **Changeset:** `core`/`cli`/`plugin-dev` `minor`, `objectql` `patch` (fixed group).
- **Follow-ups (not this PR):** three sibling remedy texts and `AppPlugin.bundle`'s undeclared reader → #23553, filed in this act.
- **CI on the head:** in progress at this act; the seat lands on green.

The card closed `completed` on `Fixes #23310`; `pm:dispatched` is removed in this act. `os serve` and `DevPlugin` leave out `plugin-auth`'s `sys_organization` default record page when the served app declares its own (`stackDeclaresOrganizationRecordPage`, `@objectstack/core`); `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`'s remedy names the page, not the package. The three sibling remedy texts and `AppPlugin.bundle`'s reader are carried on #23553.
